titleStmt.title: Sentence alignment: D'Annunzio, Il trionfo della morte (1894) and the 1913 Japanese translation

projectDesc.p: Records sentence-level correspondences between the Italian source text and one Japanese translation. One such file exists for each of the eight translations in the corpus. The correspondences are held stand-off so that neither text file depends on the other.

segmentation.p: Each link associates one or more s-units in the source with one or more s-units in the translation; correspondences are therefore n:m rather than strictly 1:1. Pointers are relative URIs consisting of the the file name and the xml:id of the s-unit. Because each witness uses its own identifier prefix, the two sides of a link are distinguishable from the fragment identifier alone.

interpretation.p: Only realized correspondences are recorded. Source sentences with no counterpart in the translation, and translation sentences with no counterpart in the source, are omitted from this file.
